{
  "dataset_name": "adult_income",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "age_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized age relative to training mean and std, providing scale-normalized distance contribution.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Equalizes age contribution in Euclidean distance computations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 38.5876) / 13.2402"
    },
    {
      "name": "hours_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized hours_per_week using training statistics.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes hours_per_week magnitude for distance metric fairness.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(hours_per_week - 40.8693) / 11.8470"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_fnlwgt_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed and scaled fnlwgt to reduce skew and bring it onto a comparable scale.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents heavy-tailed fnlwgt from dominating Euclidean neighborhoods.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(fnlwgt) - 12.0) / 0.6"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_capital_gain",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-compressed capital_gain to suppress extreme outliers in distance calculations.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Tames extreme capital_gain values that would otherwise distort kNN distances.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_gain)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_capital_loss",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-compressed capital_loss feature.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces capital_loss skew so neighbors are not dominated by rare large values.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_loss)"
    },
    {
      "name": "education_num_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized education_num.",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Equalizes education_num scale for distance computations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(education_num - 10.139) / 2.555"
    },
    {
      "name": "has_capital_activity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator of any nonzero capital gain or loss; an unsupervised cluster indicator for financially active rows.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Separates a distinct subpopulation that often has different neighborhoods.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((capital_gain + capital_loss) > 0, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "prime_working_age_distance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation from prototypical prime working age (40), as an unsupervised age prototype distance.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a meaningful prototype-distance signal for age-based neighborhood structure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(age - 40.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "fulltime_hours_distance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation from standard 40-hour work week.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 60.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures atypical work-hour patterns as a prototype-distance metric.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(hours_per_week - 40.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "overall_centroid_distance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance from a row's standardized core numeric features to the unsupervised training centroid (origin in z-space).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures global atypicality; useful for kNN to weight outliers.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((age - 38.5876) / 13.2402) ** 2 + ((hours_per_week - 40.8693) / 11.8470) ** 2 + ((education_num - 10.139) / 2.555) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "education_hours_similarity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Negative absolute difference between standardized education and hours, a similarity-like score for joint education-hours profile.",
      "value_range": [-8.0, 0.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes joint education-effort similarity to support neighborhood discrimination.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "-np.abs((education_num - 10.139) / 2.555 - (hours_per_week - 40.8693) / 11.8470)"
    },
    {
      "name": "demographic_stability_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Heuristic 0-1 score reflecting demographic stability based on marital_status indicating partnered (codes commonly representing married), relationship code indicating spouse/family role, and prime-age range. Higher values indicate more stable household profile, useful as an unsupervised cluster indicator for kNN.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a composite semantic grouping that improves neighborhood coherence beyond raw encoded categoricals.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
